provenance.label: Yale walk-in study spaces
provenance.detail: Open study floors and reading rooms that are not reservable on schedule.yale.edu. Coordinates are the building. No seat counts are claimed.

spaces.name: Marx Young Family Study Room
spaces.description: Open 24-hour study floor on the Marx concourse with a media wall, flexible furniture, and lots of outlets. Walk in, no booking. Busy in the evening.

spaces.name: Bass Courtyard Level
spaces.description: Open study floor at Bass with natural light and varied seating, steps from Cross Campus. Walk in; the individual rooms here are first-come. Thain Café is right there.

spaces.name: Bass Lower Level
spaces.description: The quieter Bass floor with soft seating and high-top tables. Walk in. Good for solo reading when Sterling feels too formal.

spaces.name: Sterling Memorial Library Nave
spaces.description: Silent cathedral-like reading room with long wooden tables, green lamps, and natural light through stained glass. Strictly quiet, no talking, no food. Ideal for deep solo reading, memorizing, or writing.

spaces.name: Sterling Starr Reference Room
spaces.description: Large public quiet reading room on Sterling's ground floor with the reference collection. Slightly less hushed than the Nave, more table space.

spaces.name: Sterling Linonia & Brothers Room
spaces.description: Recently renovated room in Sterling with soft seating and reading nooks. The cozy option for reading a novel for a seminar.

spaces.name: CEID Study Space
spaces.description: Open collaborative space in the Center for Engineering Innovation and Design with standing tables, whiteboards, 3D printers, and tools. Noisy and social. Good for a project team building something. Members only after hours.

spaces.name: Humanities Quadrangle Study Room
spaces.description: Small seminar-style rooms in the Humanities Quadrangle with a round table, a whiteboard, and courtyard windows. Quiet and private. First-come for students.

spaces.name: Cushing/Whitney Medical Library
spaces.description: Medical campus library with 24-hour access, some reservable rooms, and the silent Morse Reading Room. A long walk from central campus but nearly empty of undergrads.

spaces.name: Divinity Library Day Missions Reading Room
spaces.description: Majestic two-story reading room at the Divinity School, quiet and rarely crowded. Worth the walk up Prospect for a long, distraction-free afternoon.
